_comment: Peer engines for diagnostic head-to-head matches (.github/workflows/peer-match.yml), not rating anchors, though the schema matches scripts/anchors*.json, so the CCRL ladder can play them too (-f anchors_file=scripts/peers.json). clover-9.1: CCRL Blitz 3725 (per docs/peer-analysis-2026-11-19.md; no ccrl_err recorded, so the ladder assumes +-20), rustfish's net class (single layer, king buckets, 8 output buckets, FT 1280). Its net (src/quantised.nnue, 13.8 MB) is in the tag and embedded with incbin, so there is no net download. Built with build_flag=avx2 (-march=core-avx2, no AVX-512), matching rustfish's x86-64-v3 SPRT builds. Clover subtracts a fixed 100 ms move overhead from its clock and has no option for it.
